                                                             2022 Annual Report 年報
公司簡介
Company Profile
康師傅控股有限公司（「本公司」）及其                             Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp. (the “Company”), and its
附屬公司（「本集團」）主要在中國從事                             subsidiaries (the “Group”) specialise in the production and distribution
生產和銷售方便麵及飲品。本集團於1992                           of instant noodles and beverages in the People’s Republic of China (the
年開始生產方便麵，並自1996年起擴大業                           “PRC”). The Group started its instant noodle business in 1992, and
務至方便食品及飲品；2012年3月，本集團                          expanded into instant food business and beverage business in 1996.
進一步拓展飲料業務範圍，完成與PepsiCo                         In March 2012, the Group further expanded its beverage business by
中國飲料業務之戰略聯盟，開始獨家負責                             forming a strategic alliance with PepsiCo for the beverage business in
製造、灌裝、包裝、銷售及分銷PepsiCo                          the PRC. The Company exclusively manufactures, bottles, packages,
於中國的非酒精飲料。「康師傅」作為中                             distributes and sells PepsiCo soft drinks in the PRC. After years of hard
國家喻戶曉的品牌，經過多年的耕耘與積                             work and accumulation, “Master Kong” has become one of the best-
累，深受中國消費者喜愛和支持。                                known brands among consumers in the PRC.

康師傅作為快消品行業的領導品牌，肩負                             Being a leading brand in the fast moving consumer goods industry,
引領行業食品安全與質量保障的使命，本                             Master Kong has to hold the industry responsibility of food safety
集團不斷構建和完善管理體系，建立風險                             and quality guarantee. The Group constantly builds and improves
預防管理機制，實施食品安全的全方位控                             management system, establishes risk prevention management system,
制，確保產品質量與安全，為廣大消費者                             implements entire control over food safety and ensures product quality
提供安全、美味、健康的食品。                                 and safety. We will constantly strive for product quality and food safety,
                                               as well as provide consumers with safe, tasty and healthy food products.

本集團不斷完善遍佈全國各地的銷售網                              The Group distributed its products throughout the PRC through
絡，令新產品更加快速、有效地登陸市                              its extensive sales network consisting of 337 sales offices and 322
場，使得集團產品處於行業領先地位。截                             warehouses serving 76,528 wholesalers and 254,975 direct retailers
至2022年12月31日，本集團共擁有337個                        as of 31 December 2022. This extensive sales network is a significant
營業所及322個倉庫以服務76,528家經銷商                        contributor to the Group’s leading market position and it enables the
及254,975家直營零售商。                                Group to introduce new products rapidly and effectively.

本公司於1996年2月在香港聯合交易所有限                          The Company was listed on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited
公司上市。於2022年12月31日，本公司之                         in February 1996. Market capitalisation as at 31 December 2022 was
市值達100億美元。現時本公司為摩根士丹                           US$10 billion. The Company is a constituent stock of Morgan Stanley
利資本國際(MSCI)中國指數成份股及恒生指                         Capital International (MSCI) China Index and Hang Seng Index.
數成份股。

今後，本集團仍將發展焦點集中於食品製                             Focused on food manufacture, sales and distribution business, the
造、行銷及流通行業，並繼續強化通路與                             Group will continue to strengthen its logistics and sales network in the
銷售系統網絡，以建立「全球最大中式方                             PRC with target of becoming “The largest Group for Chinese Instant
便食品及飲品集團」為奮鬥目標。                                Food & Beverage in the World”.

主席報告
Chairman’s Statement
康師傅以「弘揚中華飲食文化」為初心，以                Master Kong remains true to its original aspiration of “Promoting
「服務消費者」為宗旨，以「食品安全」為基               Chinese Food & Beverage Culture”, takes “Serving Consumers” as
石，致力於打造綜合型食品飲料「民族品                 its purpose, and “Food Safety” as its cornerstone, and devotes itself
牌」。                                to creating a “Chinese National Brand” of comprehensive food and
                                   beverages.

2022 年康師傅積極應對疫情、原材料價格              In 2022, Master Kong actively responded to the challenges, such as
波動等挑戰，取得業績穩健增長。                    COVID and fluctuations of raw material prices, and achieved steady
                                   growth in performance.

在「鞏 固、 革 新、 發 展 」戰 略 指 引 下， 康      Guided by the strategy to “Consolidate, Reform and Develop”, Master
師傅不斷優化產品組合，為消費者提供更                 Kong has been optimizing its product portfolio every step of the way to
多優質產品。追求美味的同時，響應「健                 offer more quality products to consumers. In pursuit of deliciousness,
康中國」號召，推出多款減糖減油產品。                 Master Kong has also responded to the call of “Healthy China” and
此外，康師傅通過彈性靈活的供應鏈、對                 launched a variety of sugar-reduced and oil-reduced products. In
消費行為變化的追蹤、精細的渠道經營，                 addition, Master Kong has ensured proper production and shipment
確保疫情封控期間的生產供貨及消費者服                 as well as consumer services during the COVID control and lockdown
務。                                 periods, with flexibility of supply chains, consumption behaviors tracking
                                   and refined channel operation.

康師傅注重可持續發展。響應國家「雙碳                 Master Kong pays its attention to sustainable development. In response
方針」積極推動碳排查和節能減排，推出                 to the national guideline of “Carbon Peaking and Carbon Neutrality”,
無標簽產品，發佈國內首創茶飲料雙碳標                 active measures have been taken to promote carbon inventory
準。持續推動數字化轉型，建設專業人才                 investigation and energy conservation and emission reduction, launch
隊伍，以尋求長遠發展。                        unlabeled products, and release the first standards of “Carbon Footprint
                                   Accounting and Carbon Neutralization Evaluation” for tea beverages
                                   in China. With a view to long-term development, constant efforts
                                   have been made to drive digital transformation and build a team of
                                   professional talents.

隨著疫情管控放開，我們有信心應對 2023              With the reopening from the adjustment of COVID measures, we are
年的市場挑戰。董事會將繼續敦促管理團                 confident to rise to the market challenges in 2023. The Board will
隊健康經營、服務消費者。在此，我對股                 prompt the management team, on an ongoing basis, to operate in a
東、董事會同仁、管理層、員工、合作夥                 healthy manner and to serve consumers better. Here, I would like to
伴 及 消 費 者 多 年 來 的 支 持， 致 以 衷 心 感   express my heartfelt gratitude to all the shareholders, fellow members
謝。                                 of the Board, management team, employees, partners and consumers
                                   for their support over the years.

     康師傅積極響應國家減塑政策                      Master Kong actively responds to the national plastic

     理念。                                implement the concept of sustainable development.

     少包材使用和廢棄物產生。                       and reducing the use of packaging materials and generation

                ECL 的計量                                         Measurement of ECL

                ECL 是 對 金 融 工 具 預 期 存 續 期                       ECL is a probability-weighted estimate of credit losses (i.e.
                的信貸虧損（即所有現金短缺的                                  the present value of all cash shortfalls) over the expected life
                現值）的概率加權估計。                                     of the financial instrument.

                就金融資產而言，信貸虧損為                                   For financial assets, a credit loss is the present value of the
                應付合約實體的合約現金流量                                   difference between the contractual cash flows that are due
                與該實體預期收取的現金流量                                   to an entity under the contract and the cash flows that the
                之間的差額的現值。                                       entity expects to receive.

                整個存續期 ECL 代表將在金融                                Lifetime ECL represents the ECL that will result from all
                工具的預期存續期內發生的所                                   possible default events over the expected life of a financial
                有可能違約事件的 ECL，而 12                               instrument while 12-month ECL represents the portion of
                個月的 ECL 代表預期由金融工                                lifetime ECL that is expected to result from default events
                具的違約事件產生的整個存續                                   on a financial instrument that are possible within 12 months
                期 ECL 其 中 部 分， 該 部 分 在 報                        after the reporting date.
                告 日 期 之 後 12 個 月 內 可 能 發
                生。

                如果 ECL 是在集體基礎上計量                                Where ECL is measured on a collective basis, the financial
                的，則金融工具按以下一個或                                   instruments are grouped on the following one or more
                多個共享信貸風險特徵分組：                                   shared credit risk characteristics:

                (i)     逾期還款信息                                  (i)     past due information

           據輸入。估值以收益資本化法                                   using income capitalisation approach and direct comparison
           及 直 接 對 比 法 得 出（2021 年：                         approach (2021: income capitalisation approach).
           收益資本化法）。

           於收益資本化法估值中，商業                                   In income capitalisation approach, the market rentals of all

           金乃參考可租出單位達到的租                                   reference to the rentals achieved in the lettable units as well
           金以及鄰近類似物業的其他租                                   as other lettings of similar properties in the neighbourhood.
           用情況評估所得。當中所用的                                   The capitalisation rate adopted is made by reference to the
           資本化比率乃經參考估值師就                                   yield rates observed by the valuer for similar properties in
           該地區的類似物業觀察所得的                                   the locality and adjusted based on the valuer’s knowledge
           收益率，再經根據估值師所知                                   of the factors specific to the respective properties. In direct
           就相對應物業有關的特定因素                                   comparison approach, comparable’s average unit selling
           調整後採用。於直接對比法估                                   prices are referenced to comparable sales transactions as

    成本及賬面值                        Cost and carrying amount
        於 2021 年 12 月 31 日及          At 31 December 2021 and
          2022 年 12 月 31 日             31 December 2022                                    97,910             97,910


    商 譽 產 生 的 原 因 是， 為 收 購 付 出 的                    Goodwill arose because the consideration paid for the acquisition
    代 價 實 際 上 包 括 了 與 收 入 增 長， 未                    effectively included amount in relation to the benefits originated
    來市場發展和被收購企業的組合勞                                 from revenue growth, future market development and the
    動 力 相 關 的 收 益。 這 些 利 益 不 與 商                    assembled workforce of the acquired business. These benefits
    譽 分 開 確 認， 因 為 它 們 不 符 合 可 識                    are not recognised separately from goodwill because they do not
    別 無 形 資 產 的 確 認 標 準。 預 計 所 有                    meet the recognition criteria for identifiable intangible assets.

42. 資本管理                                        42. CAPITAL MANAGEMENT

    本集團的資本管理目標是維護本集                                 The Group’s objectives on managing capital are to safeguard the
    團 持 續 經 營 的 能 力， 為 股 東 提 供 回                    Group’s ability to continue as a going concern in order to provide
    報及為其他持份者提供利益。                                   returns for shareholders and benefits for other stakeholders.

    本集團使用根據淨負債（扣除現金及                                The Group monitors its capital, which comprises all equity
    現金等值物及長期定期存款的有息                                 components, using a gearing ratio which is calculated on the basis
    借 貸 ）計 算 的 淨 負 債 與 資 本 比 率（作                    of net debt (interest-bearing borrowings net of cash and cash
    為本公司股東應佔權益的比率）以監                                equivalents and long-term time deposits) as a ratio of the equity
    察 其 資 本（包 括 所 有 權 益 部 分 ）。 本                    attributable to owners of the Company. The Group takes into
    集團計算淨負債與資本比率時把長                                 account of the long-term time deposits in calculating the gearing
    期 定 期 存 款 計 入 作 考 慮， 因 管 理 層                    ratio because the management believes that this calculation
    認為此計算更準確地反映本集團之                                 reflects the capital structure of the Group more accurately. The
    資 本 結 構。 報 告 期 末 債 務 權 益 比 例                    debt-to-equity ratio at the end of the reporting period was as
    如下：                                             follows:

43. 金融風險因素                          43. FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT

  本集團所持有的金融工具面對外匯                       The Group’s financial instruments expose it to foreign currency
  風 險、 利 率 風 險、 信 貸 風 險 及 流 動           risk, interest rate risk, credit risk and liquidity risk. The Board
  資 金 風 險。 為 降 低 本 集 團 金 融 風            of Directors generally adopts conservative strategies on its risk
  險， 董 事 會 採 用 保 守 的 風 險 管 理 對          management and limits the Group’s exposure to these risks to a
  策。 董 事 會 檢 討 並 同 意 採 用 之 風 險          minimum. The Board of Directors reviews and agrees policies for
  管理對策如下：                               managing each of these risks and they are summarised below:


  外匯風險                                  Foreign currency risk

  本集團的附屬公司主要在中國經                        The majority of the subsidiaries of the Group are operated in the
  營， 主 要 以 人 民 幣 作 交 易 貨 幣。 本           PRC and most of their transactions are denominated in RMB.
  集團所面對的外匯風險為除本公司                       The Group is exposed to foreign currency risk primarily through
  或 其 附 屬 公 司 之 功 能 貨 幣 以 外， 以          payable on capital expenditures, purchases, bank balances,
